name: Horatio
message: My Queen, these walks are a treat. Your beauty is so great that when people see us out, I look handsome just standing next to you.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Heh. You flatter me.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Say, Horatio...

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I know nothing about you. Have you ever told me of yourself?

name: Queen Gertrude
message: My late husband often spoke of your prowess on the battlefield. But what before that?

name: Horatio
message: There's not much to tell, my lady. I'm but a poor footsoldier. Then I followed Hamlet to Wittenberg, for a time.

name: Horatio
message: I didn't care much for the area, I'm afraid. No offense to your Bohemian heritage.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: No offense taken. I consider myself Danish now. But where were you born?

name: Horatio
message: Italy, your Highness.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: Italy! What! So far from here? What is it like?

name: Horatio
message: Italy is... hard to describe. Loud and hot, and at once, brimming with quiet beauty.

name: Horatio
message: My father was a spice merchant in Venice, originally of Calicut. He sailed the route and took me with him often, when I was a boy. It was in Calicut he met my mother.

name: Horatio
message: But their love was brief, her pregnancy was a secret, and they were unwed. After I was born, my father absconded with me to Venice to save her reputation.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: How sad for your mother, don't you think?

name: Horatio
message: I wouldn't know. I saw her just once or twice when I was a boy. She was married off to another man. After that, Father and I never saw her again.

name: Horatio
message: But my father loved me dearly.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: What of your life after that? Venice, India, Denmark—you've traveled perpetually.

name: Horatio
message: Why, my lady, my secrets are the key to my charm!

name: Horatio
message: It's just a lot of nothing anyhow. I far prefer my life these days. Venice holds certain painful memories for me.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I'm sorry to hear that. Well, regardless, I'm glad you're here.

name: Horatio
message: As am I.

name: Queen Gertrude
message: I must go. Same time tomorrow?

name: Horatio
message: Of course, Your Highness.
